wiki.title: Michael Amos (politician)
wiki.extract: Michael Amos (born February 15, 1993) is an American politician serving as a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for the 27th district. He works as a physician. Amos is a Southern Baptist. He graduated from Spring Valley High School in Huntington, West Virginia, Marshall University, and the Joan C. Edwards School of Medicine.
